gen-dafont-nordic-gf-hind-vadodara: Nordic spaces its monoweight letters wide apart, like brush dabs on paper. Hind Vadodara is a sans with big open e and a and uniform thickness, so paragraphs would flow smoothly without snagging.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-huninn: Huninn is a sans-serif whose s terminals stay clear of the body. Huninn, its lowercase rising close to cap height, lets out the breath that ancient-feeling Nordic keeps pinched shut.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-inter-tight: Tightly closed letters, like a pressed leaf fold, give Nordic its ancient, monoweight look and a powerful presence. Inter Tight glides through long reading, ascenders kept low, curve tails held back.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-karla: Powerful, ancient Nordic keeps a single stroke weight and wide-spaced letters. Karla, a modern sans with a gaping c opening and a stocky middle band, takes over the text while Nordic earns its place in big, short lines.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri is friendly and easy going, its tall x-height rising skyward. Nordic pinches its ancient letters closed and monoweight, while Kedebideri's rounded sans letters open everything back up.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-khula: Nordic keeps a line width that never swells or tapers. Khula, a modern sans-serif with a tall belly and open-mouthed curves, would read comfortably over many lines of text.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-krub: Krub stands tall in the x-height, its pen-lifted curves leaving loops unfinished. Nordic does best with its closed, powerful, widely spaced letters, while Krub does best staying open and readable as a sans.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-kufam: Ancient Nordic closes its letters tight, spaced like brush dabs far apart. Kufam, a plain sans drawn like a neon tube, does the open work, its generous curves dominating the line.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-lexend: Approachable Lexend has outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve. Nordic brings closed, powerful, ancient letters up top while Lexend, a plain sans, lets the curves breathe underneath.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-lexend-deca: Clean, approachable Lexend Deca draws an unshaded line that never swells, with small capitals beside big lowercase. Nordic, closed and ancient, supplies the weight while Lexend Deca keeps terminals open.
